svg.title: Twenty-session Ridge signal diagnostics
svg.desc: Mean return by score quintile, rank information coefficient, signal summary, and top-40 outcome distribution from the corrected ten-year Ridge-rank OOS panel.
svg.text: Corrected temporal OOS, 155,513 ticker-observations, 520 weekly decisions
Twenty-session outcomes; not compounded because labels overlap
Positive mean IC did not produce benchmark-beating economics.
Same-date Spearman correlation with 13-week rolling mean
Source: ten_year_20d_rank_tail_2013_2023, Ridge-rank arm. Overlap-aware inference is reported separately.
